subject: Audit data access model — action items & ownership (triage)
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena@brighthealth.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: security@brighthealth.com
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Audit data access requirements + BYOK/KMS clarifications

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As we prepare for our internal risk review, Security has a handful of clarifying asks so we can sign off on a pilot:

1) Audit log granularity: we need to see per-request tokens for admin/API calls, a separate stream for user-visible generation requests, and an immutable event id for each inference (request_id).
2) Retention windows: default 30 days for request payloads, 365 days for metadata and access logs, with an option for BrightHealth to request a 90-day short-term exception for some projects.
3) BYOK/KMS: we want to understand key rotation responsibilities for VPC/private deployments and whether Redwood can support an HSM-backed key in our cloud KMS.
4) SSO + provisioning: we need confirmation on SCIM provisioning and whether session-level audit hooks are available for SSO-sourced tokens.

I attached our initial requirements doc (brighthealth_audit_requirements_1029.pdf). Can you confirm which items are actionable in your roadmap versus exceptions we should expect to handle with compensating controls? We are targetting a pilot contract in Q1 so timelines matter.

Appreciate a quick triage — happy to join a 30m call.

Thanks,
Elena Soto
Head of InfoSec, BrightHealth

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena@brighthealth.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit data access requirements + BYOK/KMS clarifications

Elena — thanks for the clear list and the PDF. We did an internal quick-pass and want to document owners and expected next steps so nothing falls through the cracks. High level:

- We can commit to per-request immutable ids and a separate inference log stream; implementation work is medium priority.
- Retention windows are configurable on Dedicated/Private; hosted defaults are currently 30d payload/365d metadata — we can propose a 90d temporary exception process.
- BYOK/HSM: Private (VPC) supports customer-managed keys today; HSM-backed KMS integration will require a product effort to document SLAs and rotation responsibilities.
- SCIM/SSO hooks: we have SCIM and SAML SSO; per-session audit hooks exist but need a hardened interface for exporting session-level tokens for customers.

Action owners (proposed):
- Kimberly Park (security & evidence): validate BrightHealth requirements against our evidence pack and prepare gaps list. Attachment: marissa_action_matrix_v1.xlsx (owners & asks).
- Rishi Malhotra (serving/runtime): assess engineering effort for immutable request IDs, separate log stream, and retention controls; estimate SLO/throughput impact.
- Jonas Weber (product/roadmap): prioritize the BYOK/HSM documentation + exception flow for the Q1 pilot decision and coordinate contract language with Sales.

Elena — can you confirm which of these items you need resolved before pilot sign-off vs. which can be covered by compensating controls for the pilot? If agreeable, I'll set a 30m triage on Monday 11/02 to align owners and timelines.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Product Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Marissa / team — quick technical notes after reviewing BrightHealth's PDF:

1) Immutable request_id: we already generate a request UUID for tracing, but it isn't surfaced in every audit export. We can add a stable event_id field in the audit stream; low complexity (2-3 sprint tickets) but needs product definition on which events to include.

2) Separate inference log stream: we have two logical pipelines today (control/admin + inference), but they are currently merged for some hosted customers. Splitting for BrightHealth in Private/Dedicated is feasible; for hosted customers we need a per-account export toggle — medium complexity (3-4 sprints) plus storage cost estimate.

3) Retention/exceptions: implementing a temporary 90-day short-window for payloads is policy + infra; policy can be done quickly, infra needs an ops runbook.

4) BYOK/HSM: Private deployments currently allow CMKs via customer KMS. True HSM attestations (e.g., customer HSM in a managed hardware module) will require security review and a compliance addendum.

Attachments: audit_schema_proposal_v2.pdf — draft of proposed audit fields and suggested export formats.

I'll pick up the evidence-gap matrix and populate the 'must have for sign-off' checkbox for Elena's requirements. Rishi — can you estimate the throughput/latency risk for a separate inference log stream this week?

-Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Principal Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Quick sync notes after running a brief perf/infra sniff:

- Immutable event_id: negligible perf impact; can be added as a header emitted at request start. Estimate: 1 sprint (engineering) + 1 sprint for QA/telemetry integration.
- Separate inference log stream: main cost is storage and egress. For a Dedicated/Private customer we can route to a dedicated S3/GCS bucket per-account and keep the current streaming pipeline for hosted. Implementation: 3 sprints (core work) + 2 sprints for config/ops automation.
- Retention toggles: we can expose retention settings in the Console for Dedicated/Private and provide an on-request exception workflow for hosted customers with a 72-hour turnaround from ops.
- BYOK/HSM: engineering supports CMK rotation API hooks but HSM attestation flow requires legal + compliance signoff before we promise in contract.

Next steps (per Marissa owners):
- Kimberly: provide evidence gap list and final audit_schema_v2 comments by 11/04.
- Rishi: produce a low/med/high estimate for the split-stream effort and a back-of-envelope cost delta for BrightHealth by 11/05.
- Jonas: confirm whether documentation + exception flow counts as 'deliverable' for a Q1 pilot (or if product needs an explicit dev commitment).

I've scheduled Marissa's proposed triage on Mon 11/02 11:00 AM PT (invite link in thread). If BrightHealth needs earlier, we can move.

-r
